editor_hint: Leave a field empty to use the default.
empty: No widgets configured. Add some in Settings → Plugins or with the pencil button.
name_exists: A widget with that name already exists
nothing_to_rotate: There are not enough open windows to rotate.
no_free_space: No free space available to move the window.
open_all: Open all (rotates them when they are already open)
save_failed: Could not save the widget list: {detail}
thumb_not_found: The thumbnail path does not exist or the file is empty.

fallback_mode.description: How windows are positioned. Random = a widget without a layout opens in a free spot, and clicking an already open widget moves it to another free spot (keeping its current size unless Change size too is on); Custom = use the manual fallback X/Y/width/height.
fallback_mode.label: Fallback mode

card_preview.description: Thumbnail of each widget: a screenshot of the window when it is open, live updating screenshots, animated GIF from recent frames, or a mock card.
card_preview.label: Card preview

options.auto: Automatic (screenshot when open, GIF when closed)

close_on_launch.description: Close the panel as soon as a terminal is launched.
close_on_launch.label: Close panel after launch

columns.description: Number of widget cards per row in the panel.
columns.label: Columns

margin.description: Pixel margin from the monitor edges for anchored layouts.
margin.label: Margin

output.description: Monitor connector where windows should open (e.g. DP-1). Empty = focused monitor.
output.label: Monitor

reuse_existing.description: If the command's window is already open, focus it and reapply its geometry instead of opening another one.
reuse_existing.label: Reuse open window

rotation.description: How the open windows swap places when the rotate button is pressed.
rotation.label: Rotation

rotation_sizes.description: Also swap the window sizes when they rotate.
rotation_sizes.label: Swap sizes too

width.description: Width used when Fallback mode = Custom.
width.label: Width (custom)

height.description: Height used when Fallback mode = Custom.
height.label: Height (custom)

x.description: Fallback horizontal position (monitor coordinates) used when Fallback mode = Custom.
x.label: Fallback X position (custom)

y.description: Fallback vertical position (monitor coordinates) used when Fallback mode = Custom.
y.label: Fallback Y position (custom)

preview_interval.description: How often (in milliseconds) a live card preview is refreshed.
preview_interval.label: Preview interval (ms)

fallback_random_resize.description: In Random mode, also change the window size in addition to its position.
fallback_random_resize.label: Change size too

subtitle: {terminal} · {margin} px margin · {output}
title: Terminal Widgets
